modmenu.descriptionTranslation.combind: Expand vanilla keybinds with combo support.
combind.config.title: Combind Options
combind.config.allowConflicts.tooltip: When disabled, pressing a combo won't also trigger simpler bindings whose keys are contained within it. For example, pressing Shift+E won't also trigger E.
combind.config.sequenceWindowMs.tooltip: How long after a key press the next press can still count as part of a sequence in-game.
combind.config.sequenceRecordingWindowMs: How long to wait for the next press before finalizing a sequence in the Key Binds screen.
